mentions.name: Comprehensible Input Language Learning Framework
mentions.description: This language learning framework applies comprehensible input and spaced repetition: a book the learner wants to read is translated and rewritten to match their current level, and as they read or listen it introduces new words reinforced through spaced repetition. Current work focuses on the mechanics of extracting content from ebooks.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I'm working on a language learning framework based on the ideas of comprehensible input and spaced repetition learning.

The idea is you take a book you want to read, and it gets translated but also rewritten to match your current learning level. And as you read/listen it introduces new words to learn, reinforced by spaced repetition.
